description: Structured build data for V Rising. Currently 4 defined builds covering PvE and PvP. Build entities combine weapon, blood type, armor, spells, and jewels into complete player recommendations.

builds.name: Greatsword PvE Build

primary.name: Greatsword (Sanguine tier)
primary.note: Legendary variant from General's Greatsword is best-in-slot

primary.name: Brute
primary.reason: Attack speed steroid directly compensates for Greatsword's slow swings. +Health bonus makes you tanky enough to trade hits.

alternatives.name: Scholar
alternatives.note: Cooldown reset for more Q-spins. Better for PvE where you can consistently land 8 hits.

alternatives.name: Rogue
alternatives.note: Armor-expose amplifies burst but lacks attack speed/tankiness. Viable only in coordinated PvP.

alternatives.name: Warrior
alternatives.note: Defense reduction helps sustained DPS, but Greatsword plays in bursts.

basic1.name: Sanguine Coil
basic1.note: Heal on hit — sustain for melee combat

basic2.name: Chaos Volley
basic2.note: Ranged option for pulling bosses and disengage phases

combatRotation: Opener: Chaos Volley (pull boss) → E (Lunge) close gap → Q (Spin Slash) initial burst
Damage Phase: Auto-attack x2 → charge heavy → dodge boss mechanic → repeat
Burst Window: E → Q → fully charged heavy → Heart Strike (deletes 20-30% HP in one window)
Sustain: Veil of Blood through boss when low HP → Sanguine Coil after dodge → back to rotation
strengths: Highest single-hit damage — charged heavy deals 250-400% weapon damage
Massive burst combo deletes 20-30% of boss HP in one window
You enjoy melee combat
You fight bosses frequently
You play solo — self-sufficient sustain and tankiness
weaknesses: Slow swing speed — vulnerable during charged attacks
Predictable in PvP — skilled opponents dodge charged heavy
Poor at multi-target sustained DPS
You prefer ranged combat
You want maximum PvP mobility
bestFor: Players who prefer patience and timing
builds.bossUsage: Greatsword's charged heavy has hyper armor during final frames — you won't be interrupted. Time your charge to finish right as the boss's attack lands. You'll eat the hit but trade 400% weapon damage for it. With Brute's health bonus, you win every trade against non-boss enemies.

builds.name: Greatsword PvP Build

primary.name: Greatsword (Sanguine tier)
primary.note: Legendary General's Greatsword for the +physical damage affix

primary.name: Brute
primary.reason: Attack speed is even more important in PvP — you need to land your charged heavy before they dodge.

progression.note: Bloodmoon's +Damage is tempting but Dawnthorn's +HP keeps you alive

travel.name: Veil of Chaos
travel.note: Double cast Chaos Volley through clone

basic1.name: Frost Barrier
basic1.note: Absorb return damage while charging heavy

basic2.name: Chaos Volley
basic2.note: Ranged poke — 15-20% HP damage before engagement starts

ultimate.name: Heart Strike
ultimate.note: Kill confirm on CC'd target without dodge

combatRotation: Poke Phase: Chaos Volley at range → Veil of Chaos → recast Volley (double pressure)
Setup: When they close in, pop Frost Barrier (they can't trade into barrier + charged heavy)
Catch: E (Lunge) when they try to disengage — 30% slow guarantees a partially charged heavy
Kill Confirm: Enemy below 40% HP, dodge burned, no barrier → E + Q + fully charged heavy + Heart Strike = dead
strengths: One full combo can 100-to-0 a squishy target
The threat of charged heavy is a psychological weapon — bait their dodge with cancel
Tanky enough to win trades against most builds
weaknesses: Gets kited by ranged builds if you miss Lunge
Predictable — skilled opponents will dodge your charged heavy
Struggles against fast weapons (Claws, Slashers) that poke and disengage
builds.pvpUsage: Start charging a heavy attack, then cancel it with a dodge. 80% of opponents will burn their dodge reacting to the 'incoming heavy.' Now they have no dodge, and your actual heavy is still ready. The Greatsword is a psychological weapon — the threat of the charged heavy is often more valuable than the attack itself.

builds.name: Claw PvP Build — The Duelist

primary.name: Claws (Sanguine tier)
primary.note: Legendary variant with +physical damage and +crit chance affixes

primary.name: Rogue
primary.reason: Armor expose on crit. Flurry hits 5-7 times — statistically at least one crit per use. Exposed armor = +20-30% damage from all sources for 6 seconds.

progression.note: Keep Dawnthorn for HP until Sanguine

travel.name: Veil of Blood
travel.note: Dash through enemy → heal. Second gap closer alongside Pounce (E).

basic1.name: Chaos Volley
basic1.note: Ranged poke while Pounce is on cooldown

basic2.name: Frost Barrier
basic2.note: Defensive layer. Pop before engaging — absorbs counter-burst.

ultimate.name: Heart Strike
ultimate.note: Finisher. E → Q → Heart Strike kills any target below 50% HP without defensive cooldowns.

combatRotation: Poke: Chaos Volley at range. Walk at them aggressively — the threat of Pounce forces backpedal.
Engage: E (Pounce) from outside reaction range → immediate Q (Flurry). Flurry procs Rogue armor-expose.
Pressure: Auto-attack weave between Flurry hits. They will dodge — Veil of Blood catches them.
Reset: If they survive burst, disengage with Veil of Blood. Wait 8 seconds for E cooldown. Re-engage.
Claws win through repeated bursts, not one all-in.
strengths: Longest gap closer in the game — engage from off-screen
Fastest on-hit trigger for Rogue procs
Stickiest weapon — target cannot escape without burning dodge + movement spell
Best 1v1 PvP weapon in the game
weaknesses: Squishy — no innate defense or sustain, dies fast if caught in CC
Highest skill floor of any V Rising weapon — bad Claw players feed
You prefer ranged combat
You're new to V Rising (start with Greatsword or Sword first)
builds.bossUsage: Surprisingly good at PvE — Flurry's rapid hits against a single boss trigger Scholar cooldown reset nearly instantly. Swap to Scholar blood for PvE.
builds.pvpUsage: Pounce (E) has nearly double the range of any other weapon's gap closer. You can engage from off-screen. The opponent can't react to what they can't see coming.

builds.name: Claw PvE Build — Boss Killer Variant

primary.name: Claws (Sanguine tier)
primary.note: Same as PvP — raw damage is king

primary.name: Scholar
primary.reason: Flurry's 5-7 rapid hits trigger Scholar's cooldown reset on every use — near-instant spell resets against single bosses.

combatRotation: Pounce (E) → Flurry (Q) → Scholar cooldown reset procs → repeat. With Flurry's rapid hits, Scholar resets spell cooldowns on nearly every Q use.
strengths: Rapid Scholar cooldown reset via Flurry multi-hit
High mobility for dodging boss mechanics
Excels at 1v1 boss encounters
weaknesses: Short range — you're in boss melee range
Squishy — less forgiving of mistakes than ranged builds
Poor AoE clear for adds
builds.bossUsage: Flurry hits 5-7 times in 1.5 seconds. Each hit counts toward Scholar's 'every 8th hit resets cooldowns.' Against a single boss, this means your spells are available on nearly every Q cooldown.

builds.name: Summoner PvE Build

primary.name: Longbow
primary.note: Maximum range — stay 2 screens away. Your weapon is supplemental, minions are primary damage.

alternatives.name: Crossbow
alternatives.note: For bosses with adds — AoE bolts

primary.name: Scholar
primary.reason: Every 8 hits reset spell cooldowns. With Longbow hitting from range, this keeps summon spells available when minions die.

progression.note: +Spell power — summon damage scales with spell power

travel.name: Veil of Blood
travel.note: Dash + heal. Exclusively for dodging boss mechanics, never engaging.

summon1.name: Raise Skeleton (x2)
summon1.note: 2 permanent skeletons. Your frontline aggro tanks.

summon2.name: Summon Banshee
summon2.note: Ranged spellcaster, applies slow. Place behind skeletons.

ultimate.name: Army of the Dead
ultimate.note: 4-6 undead for 15 seconds. Your boss-killing cooldown. 90-second cooldown = 1-2 per boss fight.

combatRotation: Pre-fight: Summon 2 skeletons + Banshee. Position Banshee 5-8 tiles behind skeletons.
Engage: Pull boss with Longbow. Let skeletons grab aggro first.
Sustain Phase: Maintain Longbow range. Resummon skeletons immediately when they die. Keep Banshee up.
Burst Window: Boss stationary or staggered → Army of the Dead. Continue Longbow fire.
Emergency: Boss targets you → Veil of Blood dodge → let minions reclaim aggro → return to range.
strengths: Safest build in the game — minions tank while you stay at range
Most forgiving — mistakes don't kill you when minions eat the follow-up hit
Excellent for learning boss mechanics — watch and learn while minions deal damage
High ping doesn't matter — minions do the aiming
You struggle with boss mechanics and timing
You play on high ping or with performance issues
weaknesses: 20-30% slower kill times than optimized direct-damage builds
Useless in PvP — enemy players ignore minions and rush you
Mana hungry — constant resummoning drains mana
Minions die to AoE — bosses with large AoE wipe all minions at once
You want maximum DPS and speed
You want a PvP-viable build
builds.bossUsage: Boss aggro management is the key. Many boss mechanics target your minions instead of you — mechanics that would one-shot you just delete a skeleton that costs 20 mana to replace. Army of the Dead should be saved for when the boss is stationary or CC'd.
